# P36.39 — No-JS search results page (row 380, K13 SRCH-04)

Stacked PR — head `r11/P36.39-no-js-search-results-page`, base
`r11/P36.38-search-api-serving-v2` (never `main`).

## What lands

- **`format=html` on `GET /v1/releases/{pub or latest}/search`** — the
  API's complete no-JS HTML representation of `sig.search-results/2`
  (the API `format=html` surface is T0, ADR-155 — no `<script>`),
  replacing the interim typed-501. `format=html` or a browser
  `Accept: text/html` negotiates it, for results AND errors.
- **`exports/search_results_page.py`** — the renderer: archive chrome
  (site nav + dispute link + licence line — DR-C4-02), the release stamp
  via `release_stamp_view` over the staged `sig.site-release/1`
  (`latest`/`fixed` variants on the pointer class), the searched-scope
  header strip with access-time denials named (DR-C4-09), the re-stating
  GET form, the stated spelling suggestion (SIG-SRCH-006 — "Showing
  results for …; search instead for …"), typed sections with
  evidence-basis cards and stated match reasons (SIG-SRCH-002/007 —
  derived names marked "name derived"), facet GET links with counts,
  per-group cursor paging ("More records in this licence group"), the
  collapsed acronym word-hits "show them" (`expand=1`), the K3 §6.4
  honest empty states (SIG-SRCH-008 — names what was searched; never
  research status, never a recorded absence), HTML error pages for every
  status incl. the 410 tombstone (DR-C4-10), and 320 px reflow (long ids
  in `code`, DR-C4-14).
- **"Cite this search"** — mints the `sig.workspace-state/2` snapshot
  form `/s/<pub>/search/?v=2&view=list&release=<pub>&…` in registry
  order as copyable text with J3 §8.1's interim sentence (ADR-225's
  posture until TX-13b); only registered params the route applies are
  emitted (`expand` is graph-scope — never cited).
- **`/search/` gains the one federated GET form** per release target
  (`federatedSearchHref` → `/v1/releases/<pub>/search`, SIG-SRCH-001's
  one request across every licence group) beside the per-compartment v1
  forms, which keep serving.
- **Card links ride the engine-emitted `href`s** — GX-03 entity keys
  (P36.29), never minted here; `type=` is the result type and `kind=`
  the entity type (C-07, SIG-UI-059 registry).

## Requirement stamps

**SIG-SRCH-002** (typed linked results) · **SIG-SRCH-006** (spelling
suggestions stated) · **SIG-SRCH-007** (evidence basis per result) ·
**SIG-SRCH-008** (search empty states) · **SIG-SRCH-009** (search
without JavaScript).
Cited: SIG-UI-039, SIG-UI-040, SIG-UI-059/060/088/093, SIG-ENG-042,
DR-C4-02/05/09/10/14.

## Verify

- `uv run pytest tests/exports/test_search_results_page.py` — 19 passed
  (chrome+stamp+licence, typed sections, homonyms, alias card +
  collapse, derived-name marker, stated suggestion, both empty states,
  per-group cursors, facet links, cite mint, escaping, every error
  status, tombstone).
- `uv run pytest tests/api/test_release_search_v2.py` — 24 passed
  (format=html 200 HTML + cache headers, Accept negotiation, HTML error
  pages 404/422/410 with the JSON body unchanged for JSON clients).
- `uv run pytest tests/exports tests/api` — 1542 passed.
- `npm --prefix web run typecheck` + `test:unit` (896) + `build` — green;
  the `/search/` T2 classification holds.
- `make check` — see the run ledger; known env reds identical to base
  (`test_p34_18_aliases` ×2 + the `SIG_GCP_PROJECT` sentinel; Docker
  suites skip without the daemon).
- Serving remains dark: `SIG_API_SEARCH_V2=off` mounts nothing — the
  roll is still D-P36.38-1 (`prepared_not_executed`). Nothing here
  asserts a served state.
